about: A day given its own tags, another day deleted, a tag added to the whole series, then a third day given its own place (its row holds the series' tags as a copy), then the tag for all events undone: the day with its own place, which does not own its tags, follows its series and loses the tag; the day that owns its tags keeps them exactly (x-undo-fields; decisions.md, "A day kept by an undo shows the series' tags and people it does not own"; seed 40783 case 201).
